grounds: Same fixed work: native4 CP50 model/Adam/scheduler/RNG, same saved selection51,20 actual Adam writes and80 training forwards per rank.
Compact attention forward and dQ bitwise equal to expanded for tested packed shapes; direct gradients versus FP32 SDPA under0.72% relative L2; causal and cross-sequence isolation unchanged.
Same initial model first minibatch teacher-forced LP samples bitwise equal; first gradient norm differs0.04665%.
Twenty-update policy-loss relative L2 below0.75%, final parameter sample maximum absolute difference below2.5e-5 and relative L2 below7.8e-5.

Even original expanded KV with lean guard removal has twenty-step gradient-norm trajectory difference6.67%, versus7.92% legacy-to-compact. Control demonstrates this trajectory difference cannot be attributed solely to compact KV layout.
Candidate fixed-token FP32 SDPA comparison: FA3 mean/max/RMS LP error lower than installed XFormers in this sample.
Loss formula, clipping, Adam geometry, selection, reward, total outer budget remain unchanged by implementation.
limits: Full-gradient and full-Adam-moment numeric equivalence after20 updates is not proven; moment hashes differ.
Post-update sampled token LP outliers differ. BF16 training trajectories are not bitwise identical; cause of full trajectory drift has not been conclusively isolated.
No downstream accuracy equality or entire-outer speedup is claimed before actual continuation measurements.
Diagnostic advantages use fixed five-EM sample normalization, not production grounding reward. Production retains original reward logic.
decision.execution: Replace only747219 from latest sealed full checkpoint after real terminal state; retain745198 retrieval; prove actual native4 worker/driver/data restoration and continued full outers.
